dict.string: Ozer uses the microphone so you can dictate family memories, survey notes, and in-room meetings. Audio stays on this iPhone unless you choose to keep a recording with the memory or survey.
Ozer transcribes dictation and meetings on this iPhone in British English, so notes still work offline. Speech is not sent to a cloud service.
Ozer uses the camera so you can add site photos to a building survey. Photos stay on this iPhone until they upload to that survey.
Ozer lets you add photos, video, and voice notes from this iPhone to family memories and building surveys.
